tax_rule_versions.source_authority: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT), Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

instruments.scheme_name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
instruments.issuer_name: Ministry of Finance, Govt of India (Post Office & Authorised Banks)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Partial withdrawal permitted from 7th financial year; premature closure allowed after 5 completed years for specified medical/higher-education grounds with 1% interest penalty.
instruments.source_authority: Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance

notes.compounding_balance_rule: Interest calculated monthly on lowest balance between 5th and end of month, credited annually on March 31.
notes.extension_rule: Extendable indefinitely in 5-year blocks with or without fresh contributions.
notes.court_attachment_protection: Immune from civil court attachment under Government Savings Promotion Act.

instruments.scheme_name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
instruments.issuer_name: Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Up to 50% withdrawal allowed at age 18 or passing 10th standard for girl child education; matures 21 years from opening (deposits required for first 15 years).
instruments.source_authority: Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance

notes.eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age; max 2 accounts per family (exception for twins/triplets).

instruments.scheme_name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
instruments.issuer_name: Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Before 1 year: interest recovered; 1-2 years: 1.5% principal deduction; after 2 years: 1.0% principal deduction. Extendable in 3-year blocks.
instruments.source_authority: Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance

notes.eligibility: Age 60+ (55-60 for retired civilian employees on superannuation/VRS; 50+ for retired defence personnel).
notes.rate_lock: Quarterly rate at account opening stays locked for the entire 5-year tenure.

instruments.scheme_name: National Savings Certificate (NSC VIII Issue)
instruments.issuer_name: India Post, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Locked for 5 years except on death of holder, forfeiture by pledgee (Gazetted Officer), or court order.
instruments.source_authority: Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance

notes.tax_mechanics: Years 1-4 accrued interest is deemed reinvested under Sec 80C (Old Regime); Year 5 interest is paid at maturity and slab-taxed without 80C reinvestment.

instruments.scheme_name: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS)
instruments.issuer_name: India Post, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
instruments.premature_exit_rule: No withdrawal before 1 year; 1-3 years: 2% deduction from principal; 3-5 years: 1% deduction from principal.
instruments.source_authority: Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance

instruments.scheme_name: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP - 115 Months Doubling)
instruments.issuer_name: India Post, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Transferable and encashable after 2 years and 6 months (30 months) at prescribed surrender value schedule.
instruments.source_authority: Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance

instruments.scheme_name: Post Office Time Deposit (POTD 5-Year)
instruments.issuer_name: India Post, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
instruments.premature_exit_rule: No withdrawal before 6 months; 6-12 months earns Post Office Savings Account rate (4.0%); after 1 year earns 2% below applicable POTD rate.
instruments.source_authority: Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), Ministry of Finance

notes.compounding_detail: Interest compounded quarterly and paid out annually.

instruments.scheme_name: RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds, 2020 (Taxable)
instruments.issuer_name: Reserve Bank of India (on behalf of Govt of India)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: 7-year lock-in for regular investors; premature encashment allowed for seniors: 60-70 yrs (6Y lock-in), 70-80 yrs (5Y lock-in), 80+ yrs (4Y lock-in) with 50% penalty on last coupon.
instruments.source_authority: Reserve Bank of India (RBI Retail Direct)

notes.peg_formula: Coupon resets every Jan 1 and Jul 1 at prevailing NSC rate + 35 bps.
notes.transferability: Non-tradable and non-transferable in secondary market; not eligible as loan collateral.

instruments.scheme_name: SBI Amrit Vrishti Term Deposit (444 Days)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail deposit (< Rs 3 Cr): 0.50% penalty up to Rs 5L, 1.00% penalty above Rs 5L on contracted or tenured rate whichever is lower.
instruments.source_authority: State Bank of India Retail Domestic Term Deposit Schedule

instruments.scheme_name: HDFC Bank Retail Term Deposit (2Y 11M - 35 Months)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail deposit (< Rs 3 Cr): 1.00% premature withdrawal penalty on applicable rate for elapsed period.
instruments.source_authority: HDFC Bank Domestic Fixed Deposit Rate Schedule

instruments.scheme_name: ICICI Bank Retail Fixed Deposit (15M to 2Y Peak Bucket)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail deposit (< Rs 3 Cr): 0.50% penalty (< 1 year) or 1.00% penalty (>= 1 year) on applicable tenured rate.
instruments.source_authority: ICICI Bank Domestic FD Rate Card

instruments.scheme_name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Term Deposit (390 Days - 23 Months)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail deposit: 0.50% to 1.00% premature withdrawal charge on lower of contracted or tenured rate.
instruments.source_authority: Kotak Mahindra Bank Retail Term Deposit Tariff

instruments.scheme_name: Axis Bank Retail Fixed Deposit (15M to 2Y Bucket)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail FD: first premature withdrawal up to 25% of principal without penalty; 1.00% penalty thereafter.
instruments.source_authority: Axis Bank Domestic Fixed Deposit Rates

instruments.scheme_name: IDFC FIRST Bank Retail Term Deposit (400-500 Days)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Zero premature withdrawal penalty for Senior Citizens; 1.00% premature closure penalty for regular retail accounts.
instruments.source_authority: IDFC FIRST Bank Domestic FD Schedule

instruments.scheme_name: IndusInd Bank Retail Fixed Deposit (1Y 6M to 2Y)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail FD: 1.00% premature withdrawal penalty on applicable rate for completed tenure.
instruments.source_authority: IndusInd Bank Retail FD Schedule

instruments.scheme_name: Federal Bank Resident Term Deposit (400 Days)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail deposit: 1.00% premature closure penalty on applicable rate.
instruments.source_authority: Federal Bank Deposit Interest Rates

instruments.scheme_name: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Term Deposit (5 Years)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail deposit: 1.00% premature withdrawal penalty on lower of booked rate or rate applicable for completed tenure.
instruments.source_authority: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Retail FD Tariff

notes.dicgc_act_note: Scheduled Small Finance Bank licensed by RBI; covered up to Rs 5,00,000 principal + accrued interest under DICGC Act 1961 Sec 16(1).

instruments.scheme_name: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Term Deposit (2Y to 3Y)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail deposit: zero penalty within 7 days; 1.00% penalty after 7 days on lower of contracted or tenured rate.
instruments.source_authority: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Retail Deposit Schedule

instruments.scheme_name: Jana Small Finance Bank Plus FD (1Y to 3Y)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail deposit: 0.50% premature exit charge on applicable tenured rate.
instruments.source_authority: Jana Small Finance Bank Interest Rate Schedule

instruments.scheme_name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Retail FD (12 Months)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail FD: zero penalty up to 6 months; 1.00% penalty after 6 months on applicable tenured rate.
instruments.source_authority: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Interest Rates

instruments.scheme_name: Equitas Small Finance Bank Term Deposit (888 Days)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail FD: 1.00% premature withdrawal penalty after 6 months.
instruments.source_authority: Equitas Small Finance Bank Deposit Tariff

instruments.scheme_name: AU Small Finance Bank Retail FD (18 Months)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Callable retail FD: 1.00% premature closure penalty on lower of booked or completed-tenure rate.
instruments.source_authority: AU Small Finance Bank Domestic FD Rates

instruments.scheme_name: Bajaj Finance Corporate Fixed Deposit (42 Months Digital)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: RBI NBFC Public Deposit Directions: strict 3-month lock-in; 3-6 months earns zero interest; after 6 months 2% to 3% deduction below applicable rate.
instruments.source_authority: Bajaj Finance Ltd Public Deposit Application Brochure

notes.dicgc_warning: NBFC public deposits carry 0% DICGC insurance; ranks unsecured behind Senior Secured NCDs.

instruments.scheme_name: Mahindra Finance Samruddhi Corporate FD (36-42 Months)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: RBI NBFC lock-in of 3 months; zero interest 3-6 months; 2%-3% reduction from contracted rate after 6 months.
instruments.source_authority: Mahindra Finance Fixed Deposit Rate Card

instruments.scheme_name: Shriram Finance Unnati Corporate FD (50-60 Months)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: RBI NBFC lock-in of 3 months; zero interest 3-6 months; 2% below lower of contracted or completed-tenure rate after 6 months.
instruments.source_authority: Shriram Finance Fixed Deposit Tariff

instruments.scheme_name: Sundaram Finance Corporate Fixed Deposit (36 Months)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: RBI NBFC 3-month statutory lock-in; premature repayment subject to NBFC Acceptance of Public Deposits Directions.
instruments.source_authority: Sundaram Finance Deposit Interest Rates

instruments.scheme_name: LIC Housing Finance Sanchay Public Deposit (36-60 Months)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: NHB/RBI Housing Finance Company Public Deposit rules: 3-month lock-in; penalized rate on premature closure after 6 months.
instruments.source_authority: LIC Housing Finance Sanchay Deposit Schedule

instruments.scheme_name: PNB Housing Finance Unnati Public Deposit (36-47 Months)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: NHB/RBI HFC Public Deposit rules: mandatory 3-month lock-in; 4% cap between 3-6 months; 1-2% below applicable rate thereafter.
instruments.source_authority: PNB Housing Finance Fixed Deposit Rate Card

instruments.scheme_name: IDFC FIRST Bank High-Yield Savings Account (Progressive Slab > Rs 5L)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: T+0 instant liquidity (IMPS / NEFT / RTGS / UPI). Progressive slab rate: 3.00% up to Rs 5L; 7.00% incremental slab above Rs 5L.
instruments.source_authority: IDFC FIRST Bank Domestic Savings Account Tariff

notes.progressive_slab_note: Up to Rs 5L balance earns 3.00% p.a.; incremental balance above Rs 5L earns 7.00% p.a. Effective blended yield at Rs 5L DICGC cap is 3.00%.

instruments.scheme_name: AU Small Finance Bank Savings Account (Progressive Slab)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: T+0 instant liquidity. Progressive balance slabs apply; monthly interest credit.
instruments.source_authority: AU Small Finance Bank Savings Account Interest Rates

instruments.scheme_name: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Savings Account (Slab Rs 1L - Rs 5L+)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: T+0 instant liquidity; monthly interest payout.
instruments.source_authority: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Savings Rate Schedule

instruments.scheme_name: Employees' Provident Fund & Voluntary Provident Fund (EPF / VPF)
instruments.issuer_name: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Ministry of Labour & Employment
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Withdrawal before 5 years of continuous salaried service attracts slab tax + Sec 192A TDS; partial advances permitted for housing, medical, marriage/education.
instruments.source_authority: EPFO Central Board of Trustees / Ministry of Finance Notification

notes.sec_10_12_proviso: Interest on employee EPF + VPF contributions up to Rs 2,50,000/yr (Rs 5,00,000/yr where no employer contribution exists) is tax-exempt; excess employee contribution tracked in separate taxable account.

instruments.scheme_name: National Pension System — Tier-I Retirement Account (PFRDA E/C/G Blend)
instruments.issuer_name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Normal exit at age 60 / superannuation: 60% tax-exempt lump sum (Sec 10(12A)) + minimum 40% taxable annuity. Premature exit before age 60: 20% lump sum + 80% mandatory annuity (100% lump sum if corpus <= Rs 2.5L; <= Rs 5L on normal exit).
instruments.source_authority: PFRDA / NPS Trust Scheme Returns Disclosure

notes.regime_deductions: New Regime Sec 115BAC(2): Employer contribution deductible up to 14% of Basic + DA under Sec 80CCD(2). Old Regime: Sec 80CCD(1) within Rs 1.5L + exclusive Rs 50,000 under Sec 80CCD(1B) + 10% employer (14% Govt) under Sec 80CCD(2).

instruments.scheme_name: National Pension System — Tier-II Liquid Investment Account (Scheme G / C)
instruments.issuer_name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
instruments.premature_exit_rule: Zero lock-in for regular subscribers (T+2 NAV redemption); 3-year lock-in only if Central Govt employee claims Sec 80C under Tier-II Tax Saver.
instruments.source_authority: PFRDA / NPS Trust Scheme G & C NAV Returns

notes.prerequisite: Requires an active NPS Tier-I PRAN.
